modified_caption: The bar chart illustrates the execution accuracy of two systems, NatSQL and TA-SQL, across three task complexity levels: Simple, Moderate, and Challenging, as well as a Total category. The horizontal axis categorizes the task complexity, labeled as Simple, Moderate, Challenging, and Total. The vertical axis represents execution accuracy, ranging from 20 to 60 in 10-unit intervals. TA-SQL consistently outperforms NatSQL across all categories, with the largest margin observed in the Moderate category, where TA-SQL achieves approximately 52.60 compared to NatSQL's 39.64. In the Challenging category, TA-SQL shows a slight decline to 34.11, while NatSQL remains stable at 32.32. Overall, TA-SQL demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy across complexity levels, culminating in a total accuracy of 58.19, which is significantly higher than NatSQL's 51.35.

modifications.claim: TA-SQL achieves approximately 52.60 in the Moderate category.
modifications.reality: The chart shows TA-SQL achieving 48.60 in the Moderate category, not 52.60.

modifications.claim: TA-SQL shows a slight decline to 34.11 in the Challenging category.
modifications.reality: The chart shows TA-SQL achieving 36.11 in the Challenging category, which is an increase compared to the Moderate category, not a decline.

modifications.claim: TA-SQL demonstrates a steady increase in accuracy across complexity levels.
modifications.reality: The chart shows TA-SQL's accuracy increasing from Simple to Moderate but then decreasing slightly in the Challenging category, not a steady increase.
